pullRequest.title: feat: add CM5 Programming Jig configuration and documentation
pullRequest.body: Introduced a new configuration for the Raspberry Pi CM5 programming jig, including a README.adoc detailing the image setup, building instructions, and operator account management. Added YAML configuration files for the image and desktop layer, enabling automatic login and launching of the rpi-sb-provisioner dashboard in Chromium. This setup supports user credential management via Raspberry Pi Imager and rpi-preseed for enhanced security and customization.
